title: Asian Para Games: Cyril Ongcoy takes solace in new personal best after losing bronze
summary: Cyril Cloyd Ongcoy endured a heartbreaking result in his first Asian Para Games stint, after what appeared to be a bronze medal slipped from his grasp overnight.
